name: Jaareshiah
overview: Jaareshiah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Jeroham (also called Jeremoth) according to 1 Chronicles 8:27. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture does not provide further information about his life or role. His mention serves primarily to document the lineage within the tribe of Benjamin.
namesAndTitles: The name Jaareshiah means 'YHWH plants,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's involvement or blessing, though the name itself was not given directly by God. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:27 and connects the individual to the divine through its meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jaareshiah as the son of Jeremoth (also called Jeroham) in 1 Chronicles 8:27. No additional family relationships are noted beyond this paternal connection, limiting our understanding of his broader familial context.
scriptureSignificance: Jaareshiah's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, as preserved in 1 Chronicles 8:27. These genealogies are important for tracing the lineage of God's people and maintaining the historical continuity of the tribes of Israel. While Jaareshiah himself is not highlighted for specific deeds or roles, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God's promises through successive generations.
